text: Two Rainier Beach High students were shot and killed at a bus stop at Rainier Ave S and S Henderson St, around the corner from the school, shortly after dismissal. SPS canceled activities at Rainier Beach, Sugiyama and South Shore PK-8.
A Hazen High student was charged with a double murder in Seattle. Police say he rode a bus from Renton before the shooting, which happened off campus.
A 15-year-old was shot at a gas station near Franklin High (2800 block of Rainier Ave S). The school sheltered in place.
A 15-year-old Chief Sealth International High student was shot and later died.

An 18-year-old Kent-Meridian student was fatally shot in the Campus Park lot next to the school. Two days later a 17-year-old Kent-Meridian student was fatally shot in Renton. On June 12 a student was arrested with a handgun at Kentridge High.
Police arrested two juveniles who threatened online to shoot students at Newport, Sammamish and Bellevue high schools.
A Chief Sealth student was killed in a shooting at the Southwest Athletic Complex next to the Chief Sealth and Denny campuses.
Kentwood High in Covington locked down briefly after a student brought a pellet gun. The student was arrested.
A prank call claiming a gun at Nelsen Middle, plus online threats, closed Nelsen, Renton High and Renton Academy for a day. A teen was arrested.

Social-media threat lists have named 20+ King and Pierce County schools at once, including Renton High, Kent-Meridian and Springbrook Elementary. Police have found most not credible, but they still cause lockdowns and absences.
